name: Exercise — 1 Day (Basic)
description: Simple single-day training exercise template (0800–1700). Four phases: INITEX, main exercise body, resolution, and ENDEX/AAR. Good for introductory tabletops and short drills.

items.title: INITEX — Exercise commences
items.description: Exercise formally begins. All participants acknowledge readiness.

items.title: Initial Situation Briefing
items.description: Control cell delivers opening situation brief to all participants.

items.title: INJECT #1 — First exercise event
items.description: First planned inject. Replace with scenario-specific content.

items.title: Blue Team Response
items.description: Blue team responds to initial inject. Document actions taken.

items.title: Decision Point
items.description: Key decision required from team lead. Document decision rationale.

items.title: INJECT #3 — Resolution Trigger
items.description: Final inject leading to resolution phase.

items.title: Situation Normalised
items.description: Situation brought under control. Transition to wind-down phase.

items.title: ENDEX — Exercise ends
items.description: Exercise formally concluded. All injects cancelled.

items.title: After Action Review (AAR)
items.description: Structured debrief. Review timeline, lessons learned, improvement areas.
